verdict.rationale: Convex ships a first-party 'Convex Auth' library documented to support social OAuth providers, one-time email/SMS codes, and passwords directly in the client SDK, but Convex's own docs steer developers toward third-party providers (Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS) for production auth, implying the native solution is less turnkey. No hands-on evidence or time-to-integrate benchmarks are provided to substantiate a 'minutes' setup claim.
